tool_schemas.name: create_post
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new post/page/custom post on the specified connected WordPress site via the WP REST API and writes the created record into our local post cache, returning the locally tracked post including its remote WordPress identifiers and current sync state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id is not a valid wp site ULID, wp_post_type/status are not supported, or required fields (title/content) are missing; raises NOT_FOUND if the site_id does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the stored WordPress credentials for that site are missing, expired, or lack permission to create that post type; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded. Raises CONFLICT if a post cannot be created because the remote WordPress site rejects the requested state (for example an invalid scheduled/publish transition) or a provided slug is not allowed/available on the remote site, and sets the local post to a sync_error state when the remote create fails.

site_id.description: ULID of the configured WordPress site connection (wp_sites.id).

wp_post_type.description: WordPress post type to create in the remote site.

title.description: Post title to send to WordPress and store in the local cache.

content.description: Post content/body (HTML or block markup) to send to WordPress and store in the local cache.

excerpt.description: Optional post excerpt to send to WordPress and store in the local cache.

slug.description: Optional URL slug to set on the WordPress post.

author_wp_user_id.description: Optional WordPress user ID to set as the post author.

status.description: Desired publishing state for the new post (mapped to WordPress status).

tool_schemas.name: get_posts
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally tracked posts for a given site_id, optionally filtered by post type, local status, and search, returning up to limit results plus an opaque cursor for pagination; when cursor is provided, returns the next page in the same sort order. If use_cache=true, results are served from the local cache only; if use_cache=false, we fetch from the WordPress REST API, update our local cache/sync timestamps, then return the synchronized page of results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters (including invalid cursor/limit/sort values), NOT_FOUND if the site_id does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the WordPress connection is not authorized to read posts, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if sync/listing exceeds configured rate limits.

site_id.description: ULID of the WordPress site connection to list posts for (wp_sites.id).

wp_post_type.description: Filter posts by WordPress post type.

status.description: Filter by local cached sync/status state.

search.description: Free-text search over cached post fields (e.g., title/slug/content), when supported.

use_cache.description: If true, return cached posts from the backend store; if false, fetch via WP REST API and sync.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: update_post
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing locally tracked post and applies the changes to the corresponding remote WordPress post via the WP REST API, returning the updated locally tracked record with refreshed sync metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if post_id is invalid or if provided fields fail validation (including unsupported status values), NOT_FOUND if the post_id does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the WordPress credentials for the post’s site are missing/expired or lack permission to edit that post. Raises CONFLICT when the update is refused due to an invalid state transition (for example attempting to publish/schedule/trash in a way WordPress rejects) or when fields like slug cannot be applied remotely, and marks the post as sync_error when the remote update fails.

post_id.description: ULID of the locally tracked post to update (wp_posts.id).

title.description: Updated post title to send to WordPress and store in the local cache.

content.description: Updated post content/body to send to WordPress and store in the local cache.

excerpt.description: Updated post excerpt to send to WordPress and store in the local cache.

slug.description: Updated URL slug to set on the WordPress post.

author_wp_user_id.description: Updated WordPress author user ID to set on the post.

status.description: Updated publishing state for the post (mapped to WordPress status).

tool_schemas.name: get_site
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single configured WordPress site connection by id and returns the stored connection metadata and current lifecycle status. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the site does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key is invalid or lacks access.

site_id.description: ULID of the configured WordPress site connection to fetch (wp_sites.id).

tool_schemas.name: get_sites
tool_schemas.description: Lists configured WordPress site connections visible to the caller, returning up to limit results plus a cursor for pagination. Supports filtering by lifecycle status and free-text search over name/base_url. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key is invalid or revoked.

search.description: Free-text search over site fields (e.g., name, base_url).

limit.description: Maximum number of sites to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: create_site
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new WordPress site connection (wp_sites) used for outbound WP REST API calls, storing authentication configuration and initializing the site in an active/disabled state. Returns the created site record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid URLs/auth fields, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key is invalid or revoked.

name.description: Human-friendly name for the WordPress site connection.

base_url.description: Base URL of the WordPress site (e.g., https://example.com).

wp_rest_base.description: Base path for WP REST API (e.g., /wp-json/wp/v2). If omitted, the server default is used.

auth_type.description: Authentication method used for outbound WordPress REST API calls.

auth_username.description: Username used for application_password/basic authentication (when applicable).

auth_secret.description: Credential secret presented to WordPress (application password, basic password, or bearer token). Stored as a secret and referenced by auth_secret_ref in the site record.

status.description: Initial lifecycle status for the connection. Disabled connections will not be used for outbound WordPress calls.

tool_schemas.name: update_site
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing WordPress site connection configuration, including lifecycle status transitions (active/disabled/error) and authentication settings. Returns the updated site record. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the site does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields or illegal status transitions, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key is invalid or revoked.

site_id.description: ULID of the site connection to update (wp_sites.id).

base_url.description: Updated base URL of the WordPress site.

auth_secret.description: New credential secret to store and use for outbound calls; replaces the previous secret reference.

status.description: Set the site lifecycle status. Only declared transitions are allowed.

tool_schemas.name: get_post
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single locally tracked post by id and returns the cached fields plus its remote WordPress identifiers and sync metadata. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the post does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key is invalid or revoked.

post_id.description: ULID of the locally tracked post to fetch (wp_posts.id).

metadata.name: WordPress Integration Server
metadata.description: This backend stores WordPress site connections and a synchronized representation of WordPress posts created/updated/read via the integration server.
